name: Lost Tower
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

rules.note: The Lost Tower's spawn gate 42, 203,70 to 213,81: the safe hall on its first floor (Gates.cs:138, docs/lost-tower-port.md), where a death and the Town Portal land too. The Scroll of Nova falls here (sim/items.h novaScrollMap): a kill of level 60 or over, one in 1500 (the user, 2026-10-07: 'Scroll of Nova drop'; 'Scroll of Nova should drop also in tarkan'). Ours: MU's comes off Kanturu's bags. The firecracker falls here (sim/items.h firecrackerMap): a kill of level 17 or over, one in 300 (the user, 2026-10-02: 'only from dungeons like dungeon, lost-tower, bc, and devil square', then 'lets do 1 of 300 to all dungeons'). Ours: MU's was any map under Atlans while its event ran. Its last floor is a class's treasure ground (Realm::treasureGround): the travel list's last Lost Tower row (the user, 2026-10-04: 'quest item drop which can drop in lt7 or atlans').

show.places_note: Seven floors, each a region of the one grid (docs/lost-tower-port.md).

music.note: MUSIC_LOSTTOWER_A in its hall (SceneManager.cpp:1047-1073; the user, 2026-10-05).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

boids.note: MODEL_BAT01 (GOBoid.cpp:1327-1328): the bird's 1.0, its light and its 0.5 (GOBoid.cpp:1316-1320), SOUND_BAT01 alone. The cook spaces its four keys 0.25 s apart, so 6.25 for MU's key a frame at 0.04 s.

skulls.note: The skulls and chips he kicks (game/world/skulls.h).

npcs.name: Potion Girl Amy
npcs.note: named Storage01 here because the tower's own placements have no vault for him to take, as Lorencia's and Noria's do.

npcs.name: Tersia
npcs.note: Ours: Tersia (566, Npc/tersia.bmd; OpenMU's Mercenary Guild Felicia, MuMain's Korean "Guild Manager Tersia"), the shrine's last guard and the tower's quest giver (docs/lost-tower-quest.md, the user's of 2026-10-01); where the user stood and said "put her here": just inside the hall's south arches, between the two dragon-head statues, where the carpet runs out, facing it.

exits.note: The Lost Tower's, Gates.cs:138-145, and Devias's 44 (:130); docs/lost-tower-port.md §2.1. 42 is the spawn gate, the safe hall, with no direction (0); 29-41 are each floor's arrival. 1 West (-1,-1), 3 South (+1,-1), 5 East (+1,+1), 2 SouthWest (0,-1). the Lost Tower's hall: warp, death, Town Portal

enters.note: The Lost Tower's, Gates.cs:198-204 (docs/lost-tower-port.md §2.2): the door out asks 15, the first two stairs 40 and the last four 50 (OM's, not the repack's 80). Every stair goes down; no source has one back up. Each box sits in a wall niche with 2-3 open tiles, which throughGate's test of the walker's own tile handles. Floors are regions of one map, so 30-40 lead to the map they stand on, as the Dungeon's stairs do. Lost Tower 1 out to Devias

WebZen's gate.txt 62 and 64 (Season Six Gates.cs:526-527): floor 7's south end to Icarus, and Icarus's first row back. MU asks 160 in, with wings or a Dinorant (`fly`), and 50 (S6) or 80 (WebZen) out. Ours (docs/icarus-port.md, decision 2, the passes' recommendation): 160 in, which the Dinorant asks anyway (source/items/pets/Helper04.json), and the way out free. Lost Tower 7 to Icarus

hidden.note: The Lost Tower's two (ZzzObject.cpp:4020-4028): 24 the Flame vent, 95 of them, and 25 the Meteorite Trap's plate, 148, which the server's trap monster draws. docs/lost-tower-port.md.

blend_mesh.note: The Lost Tower's (MoveObject, ZzzObject.cpp:4006-4017): the light shaft's light01, the floor machines' cyan orb and the lamp posts' blue dots.

grass.note: The Lost Tower ships no TileGrass .OZT either, and its TileGrass01 is the stone floor.

anchor_kinds.note: The Lost Tower's 95 Flame vents (Object25, hidden): MoveObject's WD_4LOSTTOWER arm lights the wizard's Flame on one a frame in 64 (ZzzObject.cpp:4020-4024). Kind 5, a vent: Lamps rolls it and Play burns it (game/world/lamps.h).
